Definition: from G3056; fluent, i.e. an orator:--eloquent.
BiblicalUsage: lógios means eloquent — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Acts 18:24, "an eloquent man".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Apollos is the pattern of the eloquent believer — mighty in the Scriptures, and still willing to be taught the way of God more perfectly.
